mapper.insert: INSERT INTO validated_semantic_claim ( evaluation_run_id, session_id, claim_index, source_turn_id, exact_quote, occurrence_index, start_offset, end_offset, issue_type, explanation, confidence) SELECT candidate.evaluation_run_id, candidate.session_id, #{claimIndex, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sourceTurnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{exactQuote, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{occurrenceIndex, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{startOffset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{endOffset, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{issueType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{explanation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{confidence, jdbcType=DOUBLE} FROM validated_semantic_candidate candidate JOIN practice_session session ON session.id = candidate.session_id JOIN learning_task task ON task.id = session.task_id WHERE candidate.evaluation_run_id = #{evaluationRunId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND task.user_id = #{trustedUserId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND task.language_profile_id = #{languageProfileId, jdbcType=OTHER}
mapper.select: SELECT claim.claim_index, claim.source_turn_id, claim.exact_quote, claim.occurrence_index, claim.start_offset, claim.end_offset, claim.issue_type, claim.explanation, claim.confidence FROM validated_semantic_claim claim JOIN validated_semantic_candidate candidate ON candidate.evaluation_run_id = claim.evaluation_run_id JOIN practice_session session ON session.id = candidate.session_id JOIN learning_task task ON task.id = session.task_id WHERE claim.evaluation_run_id = #{evaluationRunId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND task.user_id = #{trustedUserId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND task.language_profile_id = #{languageProfileId, jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY claim.claim_index
